FM-1 as a MIDI output

The emulator below receives MIDI on its DIN jack. The files are played with JZZ.js and sent to the emulator, which is also registered in JZZ as the output FM-1 emulator (JZZ().openMidiOut('FM-1 emulator') from the console or another script on this page). Click in the emulator first, so the browser lets it play sound. The bank list has the General MIDI bank of the repo and a sine test bank.
